neutral_citation: [20XX] UKSC N  (for your records only, never shown to the model)
real_title: Real case name (never shown to the model)
appeal_from: Court of Appeal (Civil Division), England and Wales
facts: Neutral statement of the agreed facts, taken from the judgment's facts section. Anonymise parties. Do NOT include anything from the court's reasoning or result.

issues.question: Issue 1, framed as a yes/no question where possible, e.g. 'Did the respondent owe the appellant a duty of care?'

appellant_submissions: Summary of the appellant's case, from the judgment's account of the submissions.
legal_materials: Optional: the key statutory provisions in force, quoted.
majority: e.g. 5-0 or 3-2 (dissents make a case harder; record it)
leakage_check: Tick when a second reader has confirmed the brief does not reveal the outcome
